elements.description: Disconnected run-level DQ evidence, not an occupancy dimension. Rule counts differ in grain. Use latest run and MAX ObservedCount per rule; never sum repeated historical runs.
Source action classification lookup; not a source of policy or causal conclusions.

Reporting calendar. DateKey identifies one date. Snapshot observations exist only for month-start dates in January-December 2025. Calendar contains 2015-2030; AgencyFiscalYear is unapproved and nullable.
Income source classification codes only, not personal income amounts or eligibility decisions.
Housing program. ProgramTypeKey is the dimension key; ProgramTypeCode is the stable business label. ProgramFamily distinguishes Unit-based programs from voucher programs.
Effective-dated property version identified by PropertyKey. PropertyID is a business key, not a unique SCD2 version. Use the existing snapshot-date-resolved relationship.
Source unit dimension including unknown key -1. Missing-unit observations are retained. Do not disclose unit-level or household-identifying detail.
Voucher classification lookup; filter household observations through the existing relationship.

Households Served observation at household-program-month grain; original household identifiers are deliberately excluded from this model. Use Households and category measures, never invent a unique ontology row key or distinct annual household count. Category precedence Elderly then Disabled then Workforce.

Supportive roster observations already matched by reporting month, household and own program. Use four VASH/Other measures. Original identifiers are excluded; no unique instance key or fact-to-fact relationship may be invented.

Program-month unit inventory. EffectiveDateKey plus ProgramTypeKey identifies each inventory observation. Available excludes LIHTC. Voucher inventory is not applicable. Use existing Vacant Units measure and preserve negative values.
